newsitem.title: ITALY: Low Indian rates feature ex-Italy air cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Low Indian rates feature ex-Italy air cargo market.

text.p: Over-capacity to Delhi from north western Europe has depressed air cargo rates to the Indian sub-continent from Italy, a Reuters survey showed.

The Italy/Delhi rate has shown the sharpest fall dropping to an average 2,375 lire per kg for 100 kg from 2,800 lire in April. But the 100 kg rate to Bombay shows a much smaller fall while that to Dubai is higher than in April.

But rates to Delhi vary widely from as high as 3,050 lire per kg for direct flights to as little as 1,700 lire per kg for flights going via western Europe. Rates for larger weights of five to 10 tonnes drop as low as 1,000 lire, industry sources said.

Over-capacity from north western European airports like Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Luxembourg and Paris on routes to India enables forwarders to offer very low rates ex-Italy for cargo that first can be trucked northwards from Milan in particular.
In contrast, forwarders and carriers said rates to North, Central and South America from Italy showed gains, especially to Miami and Santiago.
But rates to African destinations have dipped with those to Johannesburg and Nairobi at 2,850 and 3,900 lire per kg respectively or down by 550 and 600 lire from rates ruling in May.

Rates to Asia from Italy have shown little overall change with small declines for Japan, China and Australasia offset by increases to south-east Asian destinations like Bangkok. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
